result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are cut off, and a bottom card is partially obscured by the tab bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full label visible.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce font size, or add ellipsis/tooltip so the full restaurant name is readable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards clear the tab bar.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally; the rightmost chip is partially clipped and there is no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll with peek of the next chip and/or fade/scroll indicators so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: Delivery fee text under the clipped restaurant name is also incomplete in the visible area of the third card.
issues.suggestion: Keep fee labels fully visible within the card bounds when titles wrap or truncate.
